newsitem.title: USA: Orange County, N.C., mulls $130 million GO vote.
newsitem.headline: Orange County, N.C., mulls $130 million GO vote.

text.p: North Carolina's Orange County budget director has drafted a preliminary proposal calling for a $130 million general obligation bond referendum in November, the News & Observer said Tuesday.

The plan would raise $60 million for a new jail and $70 million for schools. It would require a property tax increase of about 85 cents per $100 of assessed value, raising the average annual tax bill by $30 to $40.
A school task force was scheduled to meet Monday to decide which school projects should be included for the Chapel-Hill Carrboro and Orange County school districts.
